integrity: The proof reduces projective equivalence to an exhaustive 24-element projective-frame calculation and checks every quadratic-form pullback with exact rational arithmetic. No numerical approximation is used.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies projective equivalence only among the four displayed representatives and does not compute a quotient of the whole realization space. An equivalent calculation in older or poorly indexed conic-pencil literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Projective rigidity of four explicit degree-seven conic-line arrangements
